bookingFaqs.question: Who can use this form?
bookingFaqs.answer: Young people, volunteers, residents, and supporters who want to connect with the BJP Yuva Morcha team can share their details here.

bookingFaqs.question: What kind of work can I help with?
bookingFaqs.answer: You can support seva activities, public outreach, youth engagement, event coordination, digital communication, civic awareness, and resident-focused follow-up work.

bookingFaqs.question: Do I need previous experience?
bookingFaqs.answer: No. The team can guide interested volunteers based on their area, availability, skills, and comfort with on-ground, organizational, or digital work.

bookingFaqs.question: How will the team contact me?
bookingFaqs.answer: After submission, the BJP Yuva Morcha team will review the details and contact you using the mobile number or email provided.

bookingFaqs.question: Can I share a local issue here?
bookingFaqs.answer: Use the Community page for detailed local concern reporting with location and photo upload. This page is mainly for BJP Yuva Morcha participation.
